title: Better Netherite in my opinion.
description: This resource pack makes netherite look a little more like the nether in my opinion.
body: This mod adds better netherite textures in my opinion. I have edited every netherite item even ancient debris. I tried to add more lava colors to make the netherite look more like the nether, because I think the normal netherite looks more like it would be in the deep dark biome. This was made in MCreator.
